goal: Verify that all 9 RAG modes work E2E, new query-processor and generation endpoints respond correctly, and prompt overrides are saved and used at runtime.
preconditions_global: Phase 3 completed and green — query pipeline works, SSE streaming works
docker-compose up -d — all services running (check health on each port)
Project with an indexed document (status 'indexed') — save $PROJECT_ID
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in .env and services reloaded

scenarios.description: POST /decompose breaks a complex question into 2-4 sub-questions. Uses instructor + Pydantic (structured output) with max_retries=2. Called directly to the service.

steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8003/decompose' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "What are the risks of combining warfarin with aspirin, and what monitoring is required for a patient also taking statins?"}'

expected_response_shape.original_query: What are the risks of combining warfarin with aspirin, and what monitoring is required for a patient also taking statins?

checks: each sub-question is a string > 10 characters
sub-questions collectively cover the original question (warfarin+aspirin AND statins AND monitoring)

steps.action: Decompose a simple question — should return 1-2 sub-questions

scenarios.title: Query Processor — /triage (routing for RARE-RAG)
scenarios.description: POST /triage classifies a question by complexity and conflict_risk, returns a route decision. Instructor + structured output guarantees correct fields.

steps.action: Triage a simple question — expected route: vanilla or query_rewriting

steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8003/triage' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "What is the standard dose of aspirin for pain relief?"}'
checks: complexity is one of: simple, standard, complex, multi_hop
conflict_risk is one of: low, medium, high
route is one of the 8 available modes

scenarios.title: Generation — /detect_conflict (conflicting evidence detection)
scenarios.description: POST /detect_conflict accepts a list of chunks and returns has_conflict (bool), confidence (float) and reasoning. Instructor + structured output, max_retries=2.

steps.action: Chunks without conflict — has_conflict should be false
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist used as anticoagulant.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Warfarin inhibits VKORC1 enzyme, reducing clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.", "score": 0.8, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Warfarin is a vitamin K antagonist used as anticoagulant.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Warfarin inhibits VKORC1 enzyme, reducing clotting factors II, VII, IX, X.", "score": 0.8, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
checks: has_conflict == false (both chunks describe the same mechanism consistently)

steps.action: Chunks with conflicting recommendations — has_conflict should be true
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Low-dose aspirin (81mg) combined with warfarin is generally safe and recommended for patients with mechanical heart valves.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Concurrent use of aspirin and warfarin significantly increases the risk of major bleeding and should be avoided in most patients.", "score": 0.85, "document_id": "d2"}]}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/detect_conflict' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Low-dose aspirin (81mg) combined with warfarin is generally safe and recommended for patients with mechanical heart valves.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}, {"chunk_id": "c2", "content": "Concurrent use of aspirin and warfarin significantly increases the risk of major bleeding and should be avoided in most patients.", "score": 0.85, "document_id": "d2"}]}'
checks: reasoning mentions the contradiction between recommendations (recommended vs should be avoided)

scenarios.title: Generation — /evaluate (answer grounding evaluation)
scenarios.description: POST /evaluate accepts query + answer + chunks and returns score (0.0-1.0) + reasoning. Instructor + structured output. Used by SelfReflection and RARE-RAG.

Combined with warfarin, it significantly increases bleeding risk.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8006/evaluate' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "answer": "Yes, aspirin significantly increases bleeding risk when combined with warfarin by inhibiting platelet function [SOURCE_1].", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Aspirin inhibits platelet aggregation via COX inhibition. Combined with warfarin, it significantly increases bleeding risk.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}]}'
checks: score > 0.7 — answer is well grounded in context
reasoning explains why the score is high

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8006/evaluate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"query": "Does aspirin interact with warfarin?", "answer": "Aspirin is completely safe to combine with warfarin with no risk of interaction whatsoever.", "chunks": [{"chunk_id": "c1", "content": "Aspirin combined with warfarin significantly increases bleeding risk and requires careful monitoring.", "score": 0.9, "document_id": "d1"}]}'

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'

scenarios.title: Pipeline — multi_agent E2E (MA-RAG)
scenarios.description: Multi-Agent runs 3 parallel retrievals with different perspectives (mechanism, risks, dosing), deduplicates chunks and reranks everything. Typically returns more diverse citations than vanilla.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "multi_agent"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "multi_agent"}'

steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Logs: docker logs medrag-orchestrator-1 --tail 20. You should see 'multi_agent aggregation total_unique_chunks=N'. May be ~30% slower than vanilla due to 3 parallel retrievals.

scenarios.title: Pipeline — corrective_rag E2E
scenarios.description: Corrective RAG checks chunk scores after retrieval — if < 30% have score >= 0.3, it triggers fallback retrieval with alpha=0.3 and top_k*2. Fallback is visible in logs.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "corrective_rag"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "corrective_rag"}'

steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "warfarin aspirin interaction bleeding risk", "stream": false}'

steps.action: Unrelated query — fallback MAY be triggered

steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the combined risks for a patient taking warfarin, aspirin, and a statin, and what INR monitoring schedule should be followed?", "stream": false}'

scenarios.title: Pipeline — rare_rag E2E (RARE-RAG auto-router)
scenarios.description: RARE-RAG triages the question via /triage, delegates to the appropriate sub-pipeline, evaluates grounding. If score < 0.5, retries with self_reflection. If score < 0.3, abstains.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "rare_rag"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "rare_rag"}'

steps.action: Simple question — should be routed to vanilla/query_rewriting
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin used for?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin used for?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Logs: 'rare_rag triage result route=vanilla' (or another simple mode)

steps.action: Complex question — RARE-RAG will select an advanced pipeline
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the combined risks for a patient on warfarin, aspirin, and a CYP3A4 inhibitor, considering conflicting guideline recommendations?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What are the combined risks for a patient on warfarin, aspirin, and a CYP3A4 inhibitor, considering conflicting guideline recommendations?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Logs: 'rare_rag triage result route=iterative_multihop' or 'madam_rag'. Grounding score visible.

steps.action: Verify the abstained field in the response schema
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the cure for all diseases?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is the cure for all diseases?", "stream": false}'
steps.notes: Question with no answer in the database. May abstain (abstained: true) or respond 'cannot provide reliable answer'. Check the abstained field in the response.

scenarios.title: Prompt override — runtime use of overridden template
scenarios.description: Verifies end-to-end that the prompt override saved in Mongo is actually used during generation. Uses a very specific override with a unique keyword that should appear in the response.

steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "vanilla"}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"rag_mode": "vanilla"}'

steps.action: Add prompt override with a unique marker
steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"prompt_overrides": {"generate_system": "You are a medical assistant. ALWAYS start your response with the word MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER. Use sources [SOURCE_N] inline."}}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request PATCH 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"prompt_overrides": {"generate_system": "You are a medical assistant. ALWAYS start your response with the word MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER. Use sources [SOURCE_N] inline."}}'

steps.action: Send query — check if MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER appears in the response
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": false}'
checks: answer starts with 'MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER' — override prompt is being used
steps.notes: If MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER is missing — the prompt override is not being passed to the generation service. Check orchestrator_service.py and pipeline base._generate().

steps.action: Delete override — prompt reverts to default
steps.command: curl -s -X DELETE http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings/prompts/generate_system -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request DELETE 'http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings/prompts/generate_system' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'

steps.action: Query after deleting override — MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER should NOT appear
steps.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": false}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": false}'
checks: answer does NOT contain 'MEDRAG_TEST_MARKER' — default template is being used

scenarios.title: Streaming — all pipelines via SSE
scenarios.description: Verifies that streaming works for 3 selected pipelines. RARE-RAG and Self-Reflection have special logic: grounding check before streaming (non-stream first, then stream).

steps.command: curl -s -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'

steps.action: Change to iterative_multihop and test streaming
steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "iterative_multihop"}' && curl -s -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.notes: Multi-hop streaming: decomposition + retrieval per sub-question happens before streaming. Possible delay before first token. Run the PATCH from step 1 first to set the mode.

steps.action: Change to rare_rag and test streaming
steps.command: curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d $'{"rag_mode": "rare_rag"}' && curl -s -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d $'{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.postman_command: curl --location --request POST 'http://localhost:8000/chat/query/stream' --header 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'Accept: text/event-stream' --data '{"project_id": "$PROJECT_ID", "query": "What is warfarin?", "stream": true}'
steps.notes: RARE-RAG: triage + grounding check (non-stream) before streaming. Significant delay before first token — this is expected behavior. Run the PATCH from step 1 first to set the mode.

scenarios.title: Comparison of all 9 modes on the same query
scenarios.description: Run the same query for each rag_mode and compare: answer length, number of citations, latency. Collect as a table. This is a preview of the Phase 7 experiment.
scenarios.test_query: What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?

steps.command: for MODE in vanilla hyde query_rewriting self_reflection multi_agent corrective_rag iterative_multihop madam_rag rare_rag; do echo "=== $MODE ==="; curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8000/admin/projects/$PROJECT_ID/settings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"rag_mode\": \"$MODE\"}" > /dev/null; time curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/chat/query -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"project_id\": \"$PROJECT_ID\", \"query\": \"What are the risks of combining aspirin and warfarin?\", \"stream\": false}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'answer_len={len(d[\"answer\"])} citations={len(d[\"citations\"])}')"; done
steps.notes: Bash script — run in terminal. Expected table: rag_mode | answer_len | citations | time. self_reflection and rare_rag will be slowest (additional LLM calls). iterative_multihop may produce the longest answers.
